method: 9 actual local Ollama topic selections through isolated FastAPI; 3 authored questions repeated 3 times. Separate from mocked tests. One counted preload. Same fictional host-run ID/database retained after restart.

preload.output: Local model preloaded. The UI still defaults to mocked replies.

observed.text: Choose from three practices on the Practice page: paced breathing, 5–4–3–2–1 grounding, or STOP. Each has a 60-second guided sequence, with Pause for more time and End whenever you choose. Grounding moves through seeing, feeling, hearing, smelling and tasting; the interface offers recalled examples when a sense is unavailable. STOP follows Stop, Take a step back, Observe, and Proceed mindfully. No response or written answer is required.

cases.question: What is the purpose of mello?

observed.text: mello gives you a simple place to try three short practices: paced breathing, 5–4–3–2–1 grounding and STOP. You choose a practice, follow the reviewed steps, and pause or stop whenever you want. I can help you find features, explain the practices, and explore the reading shelf.
